rows.title: A germinal products notification picks its transporter from the germinal set's own transporter list
rows.detail: A trader making a germinal products notification has to say who is transporting the consignment, and the germinal journey has no transporter step of its own. The germinal products set gets its own transporter list page, built as a copy of the live animals transporter list in the germinal set and reached at the germinal notification path with the same slug. Transporters belong to the trader's organisation rather than to a set, so the germinal list offers the same transporters a live animals notification offers, and a transporter added on either kind of notification is on the other's list next time. The list has no add pages of its own: its 'Add a transporter' button opens the add-a-transporter pages the address book front door serves, in journey mode, and the trader lands back on the germinal list on save or on cancel. The germinal list carries none of the live animals list's transporter authorisation guidance: it shows the heading and one sentence of intro only.
acceptanceCriteria: In a germinal products notification, the transport step opens a transporter list page headed 'Transporter details', with the intro 'This is the person or company responsible for transporting the consignment.', a 'Search' box hinted 'Name, address or approval number' with a 'Search' button, an 'Add a transporter' button, and a 'Select a transporter' table of radio rows with the columns Name, Address, Approval number, Type and Status and a 'View details' link on each row. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-101; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-001)

On the germinal transporter list, the heading 'Transporter details' is followed by the one paragraph 'This is the person or company responsible for transporting the consignment.' and then the 'Search' box, with no other text between them. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-124; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-058, -p3-059, -p3-060; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p9-009; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-001, repo-frontend-p12-007)

The germinal transporter list shows each transporter's type as 'Commercial' or 'Private' and its approval status as 'Approved' or 'New', and says how many are shown, reading '1 transporter shown' for one transporter and '8 transporters shown' for eight. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-102; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-024, repo-frontend-p12-033)

The germinal transporter list shows at most eight transporters a page, with pagination below the table whose links carry the search term and the chosen transporter, no pagination where eight or fewer are found, and an inset between the search box and the table naming the transporter the trader has chosen. (ruling:ian-2026-11-25 ruling-ian-2026-11-25-p1-007, -p1-022, -p1-025, -p1-035-m1)

Where a search leaves no row, the germinal transporter list shows 'No transporters match your search.' in place of the table. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-101; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-033)

Saving the germinal transporter list with no transporter chosen keeps the trader on the list and shows the one error 'Select a transporter from the list', in the error summary and against the list. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p2-072, -p2-084, -p2-094; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-044)

The germinal transporter list offers the transporters the address book holds for the signed-in trader's organisation, so a transporter added while making a live animals notification is on the list of that organisation's next germinal products notification, ready to pick, and one added while making a germinal products notification is on its next live animals notification's list. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057; ruling:ian-2026-11-06 ruling-ian-2026-11-06-p1-002; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-029, repo-frontend-p12-061; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p2-072, -p2-084, -p2-094)

From the germinal transporter list, 'Add a transporter' opens the add-a-transporter pages the address book front door serves, in journey mode, and the germinal products set serves no transporter add pages of its own. (ruling:ian-2026-11-06 ruling-ian-2026-11-06-p1-012, -p1-055; ruling:ian-2026-11-06 ruling-ian-2026-11-06-p1-002)

Saving a transporter on those add pages lands the trader back on the germinal transporter list under a success banner titled 'Success' reading '<transporter name> transporter added', with the new transporter in the list ready to pick, and cancelling lands them back on the germinal transporter list with the transporter the notification already had still ticked. (ruling:ian-2026-11-06 ruling-ian-2026-11-06-p1-012; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-056, repo-frontend-p13-092)

Picking a transporter on a germinal products notification and saving keeps it ticked when the trader opens the germinal transporter list again. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-102; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-042)

A germinal transporter list opened from the germinal notification view keeps that trail: its Back link returns to the view, and a transporter saved from the add pages lands back on that same trailed list. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p13-092, repo-frontend-p13-096)

The germinal transporter list is at the germinal products notification path followed by the live animals transporter list's slug, so the address book front door's add pages return the trader to it. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-001; ruling:ian-2026-11-06 ruling-ian-2026-11-06-p1-012)

rows.notes: Keeps the existing row inc-178, its id, its germinal-products theme and its dependsOn on the germinal set's foundation row (inc-176). Pass 1 gave two slices on one page, the germinal transporter list (req-1820) and its content without the live-animal authorisation guidance (req-2638); pass 2 combines them because they share one page, one feature folder and one set-up. Neither requirement changed since the last distil, so the criteria stand as they were; checked against c-385 (whose overruled claims repo-frontend-p13-001 and -p13-002 this row does not cite) and c-471 (the banner criterion quotes the name as the trader entered it, matching that question's default). The germinal set does not exist on main yet (only sets/live-animals), so the code lives under sets/germinal-products, which no split-off theme touches: it stays here rather than going to the transporters branch. The add pages are the address book front door's, so the germinal set copies the list only. Combiner: the 'Add a transporter' and save-and-return criteria can only be observed once the transporters branch has built the journey-mode transporter hand-off (req-2264) and the live-animals list this copies; give the row an externalDependsOn on shared/design-release-2-1/themes/transporters for that, as the earlier notes asked. Stands alone from the other germinal rows: merging would carry more than about 15 criteria.

rows.title: Waiting on design: address search's search-only layout, results as the trader types, reveal on a pick and its announcements, in the address book and the commercial transporter form
rows.detail: With JavaScript, the design starts the add-a-transporter pages on their address lookup with the address fields and contact-details section not yet shown. The lookup is parked as concept work and blocked on the INS address lookup becoming a real feature, so this waits in the deferred waiting-on-design row with the address book's own search-only layout. Without JavaScript every field shows from the start, which is already how the forms work and stays so.
acceptanceCriteria: With JavaScript, the commercial transporter form opens showing the address search and an 'Enter address manually' link-style button, with the address fields and the 'Enter contact details' section not yet shown, and pressing that button shows them. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-096, -p7-097; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p9-057)

With JavaScript, the address fields and the contact-details section are shown from the start when an address has been looked up, when address line 1 holds a value, when any address field carries an error, or after a refused save, with the search text and the chosen address still shown. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-097; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-085)
Without JavaScript, the commercial transporter form shows every address and contact field from the start. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-085; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p20-036)

rows.notes: This is the existing deferred row inc-194, which already holds req-458 beside the address book's and party pages' search-only layout. A deferred row is never changed on a re-distil, so the combiner keeps inc-194 exactly as it stands in backlog.json: its id, every field, its full requirements list, its waiting-on-design theme and its externalDependsOn. This draft names only this area's share of it so coverage sees req-458 placed once. req-458's statement has moved since the row was written (it now describes the add-a-transporter pages opening on postcode lookup steps), but it still carries its blockedBy (parked by ruling:sam-2026-11-09 point 2, deferred with address search by the 13 November design ruling, waiting on design question 10 and the INS address lookup), so it stays deferred. When address search is planned, the row is rewritten from the requirement as it then stands; its code is then the address book's transporter add pages, which the split-off transporters theme owns.
